verification.sourceGuard: QualityBlockCaptureResolveIntegrityQA validates the canonical capture source contains bindMS=false, fixed-function ResolveAntiAliasedSurface, direct readback from the canonical target, no Graphics.Blit shader-copy path, and then co-validates QualityBlockDisplayTransferIntegrityQA so resolve and sRGB/gamma assumptions cannot drift independently.
verification.runtimeGuard: At formal QA4K_ Camera.onPreCull, bindTextureMS must be false and the target must remain non-mipmapped; display-transfer QA independently requires the same native target to be non-HDR and sRGB in Linear project color space.
requiredFailureInjection: Set the formal target descriptor bindMS/bindTextureMS true and require failure before the frame is accepted.
Replace fixed-function ResolveAntiAliasedSurface with Graphics.Blit and require source-contract failure.
Reintroduce a second post-tonemap render target and require both resolve and display-transfer source-contract failure before provenance sealing.
Make the display-transfer contract describe the obsolete secondary resolve path and require the capture-resolve preflight to fail through co-validation.
verification.requiredRealEvidence: Fresh Unity 6000.3.0f1 native 3840x2160 hero/oblique/grazing captures plus 100% crops and temporal evidence. Inspect fine sash rails, foliage edges, wire guards, concrete microdetail, highlight rolloff and smooth sky gradients for resolve/filter/gamma artifacts.

note: Evidence-path integrity only. This contract cannot award Visual Fidelity points and cannot substitute for actual rendered pixel review.
